_README: Per-project ids for the pre-pr skill. Copy to the project (for example
<repo>/.claude/pre-pr.config.json) and fill in. It is NOT part of the
skill, deliberately: a user-level skill is shared across every repo on the
machine, so ids embedded in it are wrong for most of them and awkward to
Real ids are not secrets, but they are pointers into private workspaces.
Keep them with the project they belong to, under whatever ignore policy

tracker.parentTaskId: <optional: module/epic task new subtasks hang under>
tracker._note: List the real statuses. Where there is no review state, 'in progress' is correct while a PR is open — otherwise every open PR looks stalled.

apiCollection._note: Backend repos only. Set tool to "none" for a frontend repo so the check is explicitly not applicable rather than silently skipped.
